headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2023: Paul Wight announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance in a Street Fight match against Golden Jets & Ibushi vs. Fletcher, Hobbs & Takeshita vs. The Golden Jets vs. Chris Jericho vs. Kenny Omega vs. Kota Ibushi vs. Konosuke Takeshita vs. Powerhouse Hobbs vs. Kyle Fletcher vs. Brian Cage, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.36 ? a good, competitive contest. In his first match since March 2022, a returning Paul Wight teamed with Jericho, Omega and Ibushi in a street fight, taking out Kyle Fletcher with a WMD punch before Powerhouse Hobbs answered by slamming him through the hood of a car.

Flash back to 2025, when Kyle Fletcher vs. Scorpio Sky fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Collision, rated 6.57. It marked Scorpio Sky's 10th match with the title on the line. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.
Turning the clock back to 2024: Ricochet vs. Dante Martin headlined Rampage, rated 6.57.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2025, Hyan laced up for their first AEW match against Riho & Windsor & World, appearing on Collision, rated 5.61.
Looking back to 2023, when Komander & Penta arrived in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.66 ? a solid showing.
On this day in 2025, LFI (Guevara & Rush) made a statement, debuting in the main event as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.03 ? a strong outing.
